rows: Over-alum can leave wool tacky; measure by weight of fiber.
Iron is powerful and can catalyze fiber damage if overused.

Moderate toxicity means careful handling and disposal.
Tin brightens but can tender wool; use minimum concentration.
Hexavalent chrome is hazardous and not a home-dyeing material.
Indigo is physically trapped after oxidation; mordant tables do not apply.
Cellulose needs tannin-assisted coordination for good depth.
Simultaneous mordant/dye only for tolerant recipes
